$description: Wissahickon Analytics design tokens, in the Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10. color.palette holds the six brand colors. The other color groups are roles: each points at a palette color or holds a text color checked for contrast.

ink.$description: Primary dark. Headings on light surfaces and the background of covers.

pine.$description: Primary brand green. Links, accents and the wordmark's second line.

teal.$description: Secondary accent. The mark and large text only. For teal text at body size use color.text.accent.

sage.$description: Light accent. Used on Ink only.

fill.$description: Boxes and bands. Only heading, body and link text meet AA on it.

inverse.$description: Dark background for covers and footers.

heading.$description: Headings on the page and fill surfaces.

body.$description: Running text on the page and fill surfaces.

accent.$description: Teal darkened so it meets AA as text of any size on the page surface.

muted.$description: Secondary text on the page surface. Replaces #6B7D76, which did not meet AA.

faint.$description: Captions and metadata on the page surface. Replaces #928C7F, which did not meet AA.

inverse-accent.$description: Accent text on the inverse surface.

default.$description: Links on the page and fill surfaces.

soft.$description: A lighter hairline for rules inside boxes and tables.

mono.$description: Small labels, dates and figures. Use sparingly.
